description:
Convert a road network into city block polygons and calculate their area.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the road network layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/urban_roads.geojson.
3. Use the 'Lines to polygons' tool (Vector > Geometry Tools > Lines to polygons) to create a new layer representing the city blocks enclosed by the roads.
4. Open the attribute table of the new polygon layer.
5. Use the Field Calculator to create a new Decimal field named 'area_ha'.
6. Calculate the area of each block in hectares using the expression '$area / 10000'.
7. Export the resulting layer to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/city_blocks.geojson (GeoJSON format). Ensure the 'area_ha' field is included.
